title: Billing page after Stripe Checkout (?checkout=success)
caption: The billing page never claims success from the redirect alone: it reads the subscription until Stripe's webhook made it trialing or active.

states.label: Confirming your payment
states.detail: `getCheckoutSync` every 2 s; no plan offered meanwhile.

states.label: Waiting (rate limit / unavailable)
states.detail: Waits Retry-After (≤60 s) or retries with a note.

states.label: Payment confirmed
states.detail: Stripe subscription `trialing` or `active`; "Follow the set-up" when the set-up starts again.
